title: It comprises several sub-databases, especially in the following fields:
main_content:
It comprises several sub-databases, especially in the following fields:

• Metals and alloys (incl. METADEX)
• Ceramics (incl. Ceramic Abstracts)
• Corrosion (incl. Corrosion Abstracts)
Moreover, the ProQuest Materials Science Collection includes:

• Journal articles
• Conference papers
• Dissertations
• Research reports
• Patents
• Other forms of grey literature
The ProQuest Materials Science Collection contains sources that are not referenced in interdisciplinary databases, such as Web of Science.
